Settings.gradientOff: The gradient is switched off. It can be switched on under “Appearance”.

Form.isGradient: Gradient instead of a single colour

FormHelp.progress: How far the bar is filled, 0 to 100. A $value placeholder is replaced with the data of the assigned datasource: $value on its own inserts the whole object, $value.percent one of its fields.
FormHelp.min: The minimum value for the progress bar.
FormHelp.max: The maximum value for the progress bar.
FormHelp.isVertical: A flag indicating whether the progress bar is oriented vertically.
FormHelp.fillColor: The color representing the filled portion of the progress bar.
FormHelp.backgroundColor: The background color of the progress bar, representing the unfilled portion.
FormHelp.barThickness: The thickness of the progress bar (e.g., '20px').
FormHelp.borderRadius: The border radius of the progress bar (e.g., '10px').
FormHelp.isGradient: A flag indicating whether the progress bar should use a gradient color.
FormHelp.rotation: The direction of the gradient, in degrees.
FormHelp.textColor: The color of the text displayed on the progress bar.
FormHelp.valueAlign: The horizontal alignment of the value text.
FormHelp.valueJustify: The vertical alignment of the value text.
